items.text: In the git repo at /work/fixture, count the number of lines in every .md file (include untracked ones such as docs/, one.md, two.md; exclude node_modules and .git). Use e.g. `find . -name '*.md' -not -path './.git/*' -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -print0 | xargs -0 wc -l`. Report the per-file line counts and the total. Read-only; do not modify anything.

input.description: Count lines in all .md files excluding node_modules and .git

command.description: Count lines in all .md files excluding node_modules and .git

items.markdown:
共找到 3 個 `.md` 檔案（已排除 `.git` 與 `node_modules`），行數如下：

| 檔案 | 行數 |
|---|---|
| `./one.md` | 4 |
| `./two.md` | 3 |
| `./docs/three.md` | 5 |
| **總計** | **12** |

這是唯讀計數，沒有修改任何檔案。
